test: tests/cypress/e2e/ui/cacheDependencyAutocollectTest.cy.ts > Cache dependencies collected by the URL builder
observed: The nightly matrix entry 'SN-custom-context' has failed on this test every night since the test was added, while the plain 'SN' entry passes. The issue that collects the failures alternates between open and closed and was read as a flaky test. The error shown by the CI reporter is from the second Cypress attempt. The first attempt fails at a cy.request to a live file URL built as `${JAHIA_CONTEXT}/files/live${FILES}/${RENAMED}`; before() does not re-run on a retry, so the second attempt starts with the rename already applied.
error:
CypressError: `cy.request()` failed on: http://jahia:8080/custom-context/custom-context/files/live/sites/javascriptTestSite/files/autocollected-renamed.jpg
The response we received from your web server was: 400: Bad Request
environment: docker-compose sets JAHIA_URL=http://jahia:8080${CONTEXT_PATH}, the Cypress plugin sets baseUrl to JAHIA_URL, and JAHIA_CONTEXT resolves to the same context path. In the plain SN entry the context path is empty. The Jahia log shows 'Unknown locale' with error code 400.
